tools.name: run
tools.description: Strips EXIF, XMP, IPTC and GPS metadata from JPEG and PNG images in one call, with optional ICC profile removal, then re-verifies the output bytes and returns an exact report of what was found and removed — unlike common strippers that only touch the EXIF segment and leave XMP/IPTC intact.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "run" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
